thread:
aisha_cs: Kicking off Veridian warmchain bakeoff — goal: validate reserved quota (steady 6k RPS), autoscale profile, cache priming, and fallback behavior. Go-live target 2026-05-10. Ops oncall please standby. Checklist below

---
- reserve pool and warmup
- autoscale policy verification
- canary -> full ramp
- load test + eval capture
- customer enablement session
---

tom_se: Thanks — quick confirm on models and payloads? Proposing primary rw-v2-7b-q4, fallback rw-v2-3b-q4. Typical seq len avg 512, p95 ~1024.

sonia_cust: We can keep payloads ~512 avg. Veridian requires KMS envelope keys rotated within 48h window. Also need confirmation on data retention for eval samples.

ravi_infra: For the bakeoff we'll need a reserved pool of 4 A100s (or equivalent) to start. Autoscale target: keep GPU util ~65% and p95 latency <120ms. I'll provision pool Wed 03:00 UTC and attach routing rules.

eli_sre: I'll book a loadbox in prod-sandbox. Proposed run window Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Plan: gradual ramp to 6k RPS over 30m, hold 30m, then soak and decay. Any objections?

 aisha_cs: Sounds good. Add canary 5% traffic for first 10m -> validate, then 100% ramp. Fallback routing to smaller model at 80% capacity threshold. Notify Veridian ops at thresholds 60/80/95%.

 tom_se: Load script to mirror our plan (feel free to adapt):
 ```
 # stress script (example)
 hey -n 100000 -c 500 -q 100 -z 30m -m POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"<customer workload>"}' https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate
 ```
 Replace prompt payloads with the Veridian synthetic set. Make sure we collect token-level timing.

 deploy-bot: Smoke test results (pre-bakeoff): 200 OK, avg latency 85ms, p95 110ms, errors 0.2% (timeouts). Env: sandbox-veridian, config: reserved-4gpus-v1. Logs: https://internal.logs/veridian/smoke-4945

 sonia_cust: Quick SLA question — if the bakeoff shows persistent errors or >5% timeouts during warmup, what's the operational play? We need a communication plan for renewal stakeholders.

 ravi_infra: Operationally we have a 2-min scale cooldown and overflow routing to the overflow pool in us-east-1. If overflow triggers, traffic will shift to hosted-tier fallback with throttling. I'll publish the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/veridian-warmchain (will grant access).

 tom_se: We'll also attach eval hooks to capture model outputs and compute latency drift. Dump sample outputs to s3://veridian-evals/warmchain/ for QA. Please ensure PII redaction is enabled for saved samples.

 aisha_cs: I'll schedule an enablement for Veridian ops on Tue 2026-05-05 16:00 PDT — demo routing, alerts, and rollback. @sonia_cust can you confirm that time works?

 sonia_cust: :thumbsup: That works. Also please include the renewal brief in the enablement (risk thresholds, fallback timelines).

 aisha_cs: Will do. Risk policy: if bakeoff shows sustained >5% errors or repeated fallback events we flag renewal-risk and set a follow-up QBR within 3 business days. Otherwise normal go/no-go cadence. Feedback capture form: https://forms.gle/veridian-feedback

 eli_sre: Noted. I'll be on-call for the run and will post the full metrics dump in this thread after the soak.

 deploy-bot: Load test scheduled Thu 02:00 UTC. Reminder posting 30m before run.
